name: Filled Tourmaline Phial
summary: At the Pools of Arlithrien, the Filled Tourmaline Phial carries moonwell water for Corithras Moonrage. Its waters help him watch the health and balance of the growing World Tree.

sections.title: Waters of Arlithrien
sections.body: The Filled Tourmaline Phial draws water from a moonwell southeast of the road to Darnassus, on the shores of the Pools of Arlithrien. Reaching the shrine has grown dangerous as the Gnarlpine furbolgs, once peaceful neighbors, turn violently mad. Corithras Moonrage asks travelers to brave the hostile groves and bring back the water. He hopes it will help him find the deepening corruption unsettling the land.

sections.title: The Roots of Teldrassil
sections.body: Back in Dolanaar, Corithras Moonrage speaks of how Teldrassil came to be. After Shan'do Malfurion Stormrage disappeared, Archdruid Fandral Staghelm rallied the Circle of Ancients across the sea in Darkshore to plant the tree and seek the return of their lost immortality. The water in the phial reflects the state of that sacred undertaking. An unexplained sickness now spreads among the beasts and furbolgs.

faq.q: What is the Filled Tourmaline Phial used for?
faq.answer: Corithras Moonrage in Dolanaar asks for the Filled Tourmaline Phial, which carries enchanted moonwell water. He gathers water from moonwells across Teldrassil to study the spread of corruption and explain the World Tree's history to newly arrived defenders.

faq.q: Where is the moonwell for the Tourmaline Phial located?
aliases: where do i fill tourmaline phial
faq.answer: The moonwell lies southeast of Darnassus's main gate, along the shores of the Pools of Arlithrien in southwestern Teldrassil. Enraged Gnarlpine furbolgs contest the area.

faq.q: Why are the furbolgs near the moonwell attacking?
faq.answer: The Gnarlpine furbolgs once lived peacefully alongside the night elves, but a creeping corruption afflicts them. Their sudden violence is one of several signs of sickness in the young World Tree.

Corithras Moonrage is a night elf scholar and caretaker in Dolanaar. He guides young adventurers through the rite known as the Crown of the Earth, teaching the history of the night elves, the planting of Teldrassil, and Malfurion Stormrage's disappearance.

angles.text: As a druid, you carry a phial tied to Archdruid Fandral Staghelm's controversial legacy. He pushed to plant Teldrassil during Shan'do Stormrage's unexplained absence.
As a night elf, you know moonwell waters are a spiritual lifeline for the kaldorei. Corruption in the Gnarlpine groves surrounding this moonwell is an unsettling omen for your new home.
